[[Melbourne Victory FC|Melbourne Victory]] were both the defending A-League Premiers and Champions. The regular season schedule was released on 29 June 2015. The season commenced on 8 October 2015 and concluded on 10 April 2016. The finals series commenced on 15 April 2016 and concluded with the 2016 Grand Final, held on 1 May 2016. The [[2016 A-League Grand Final|2016 Grand Final]] took place on 1 May 2016, with [[Adelaide United FC|Adelaide United]] claiming their first Championship with a 3–1 win against [[Western Sydney Wanderers FC|Western Sydney Wanderers]]. {{TOC limit|limit=3}} ==Clubs== {{A-League 2014–2019 map}} {| class="wikitable" |- !
